data.desc: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. (Nasdaq: SCNI) is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of innovative immunology therapies and the operation of a contract development and manufacturing organization. The Company is developing its NanoAb platform through research collaboration and license arrangements with the Max Planck Society and University Medical Center Göttingen. Scinai also owns Scinai Biopharma Services Ltd., a CDMO providing development and manufacturing services to biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies through facilities in Jerusalem and Yavne, Israel.
